channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Where does Iran stand on Saudi-Pakistan-Turkiye pact?
item.description: Iran not immediately threatened by pact, analysts say, with officials focusing on aspect of diminishing US role.

item.title: War on Iran: Phase II: Day 29
item.description: Iran says the Strait of Hormuz will remain restricted unless the US meets a series of demands.

item.title: Why does Iran defeat the empires trying to conquer it?
item.description: On the second episode of Deja Vu, we look at Iran and the great powers that have tried to shape it.

item.title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
item.description: Israel's PM says its military will not pull out from Gaza until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.

item.title: Israel accused of weaponising archaeology at ancient West Bank sites
item.description: Israel is planning large-scale land expropriations in historic, Palestinian areas of the West Bank.

item.title: Hormuz talks positive, Oman says, as Iran warns deal would not open strait
item.description: Both sides suggest progress in talks to agree a new shipping route through the strait, but a breakthrough remains unclear.

item.title: Child among three killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv
item.description: Russia continued its overnight attacks after President Volodymyr Zelensky warned of Ukraine's dwindling supplies of missile interceptors.

item.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
item.description: Eight people were killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school before shooting himself dead.

item.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
item.description: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: Kidnapped rare Serbian eagle freed into wild after rescue
item.description: Feliks the eagle was abducted as he first flew the nest in Serbia and wound up in the Middle East with poachers who demanded a ransom.
